title: Template:Talkcreate/doc
content: ;Description :This template is used to create a link to start a new discussion. It is especially useful in areas that newbies commonly frequent. ;Syntax :Type {{t|talkcreate}} wherever you wish the link to appear. You can add an optional second parameter to change the link text. ;Sample output :{{talkcreate}} gives... :{{talkcreate}} :{{talkcreate|Spout your views!}} gives... :{{talkcreate|Spout your views!}} [[Category:General wiki templates|{{PAGENAME}}]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
